title: ipomoea cheliensis
intro: Ipomoea cheliensis, commonly known as the Himalayan morning glory, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. It has been used in traditional medicine to provide relief from various health issues, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea cheliensis include analgesic, anti-ulcer, and antidiabetic effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as pain, ulcers, and diabetes. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
